scope: Audit of retained accepted evidence, not new mechanic research or current format legality.

groups.label: Rules-backed entries
groups.description: Specific Comprehensive Rules material, including named variants and concepts. This is evidence scope, not a format-legality claim.

groups.label: Official ability words
groups.description: Officially documented ability words and families. The general ability-word rule is not an individual mechanic definition.

groups.label: Card-specific labels
groups.description: Flavor words and other labels tied to particular cards. Their text is not a general mechanic definition.

groups.label: Digital / Alchemy material
groups.description: Official digital mechanic references and separately identified card-specific evidence.

groups.label: Special-format and Un-set material
groups.description: Rules and references with an explicit special context. No blanket card-legality claim is made.

groups.label: Official preview references
groups.description: Evidence retained from an official preview; kept separate from rules-backed entries.

groups.label: Playtest material
groups.description: Playtest-card records. These are not presented as ordinary mechanics or ordinary example-card choices.

groups.label: Designer-only material
groups.description: A designer publication supports a narrow example, not an established general rules definition.

groups.label: Scope not established
groups.description: The retained evidence does not establish a more specific scope. No ordinary-mechanic status is inferred.
